## Researcher

### Actions Taken
- Read the report.
- Read the Live Activity code in the app.
- Read the server engine that starts, updates and ends each activity.

### Result
- Cause 1: the engine keeps a problem card that has a task until someone pushes Done, even when the problem is gone and the vacuum does its job again. This is why the card stayed after the vacuum went back to its dock.
- Cause 2: when Resume fails, the engine sends a reason for one update, but the problem card in the app did not draw it. This is why the card went from "Resuming" back to the buttons with no reason.

### Next Steps
- Cause 1 is corrected in the Home Assistant integration `SFenton/ha-fenton-home` (`engine.py`, `live_jobs.py`): a problem card with a task also ends when the problem is clear and the device does its job again. Built and tested on branch `fix/problem-card-ends-when-job-resumes`; not pushed (the agent login has no push access) and not installed on the server.
- Cause 2 is corrected in this pull request.
